actions.label: Natural Step
actions.description: No external Thermal Impulse; resolve restoring force and one Thermal Step.

actions.label: Thermal Push Hot
actions.description: Add +1 Thermal Impulse before restoring force.

actions.label: Thermal Push Cold
actions.description: Add -1 Thermal Impulse before restoring force.

actions.label: Stabilizing Step
actions.description: Apply an impulse against current Drift, then resolve restoring force.

scenarios.label: T1 Natural Oscillation
scenarios.description: Temperature starts away from Set Point with zero Drift.

scenarios.label: T2A Expanding Hot
scenarios.description: Hot-side expansion before the current-side apex.

scenarios.label: T2B Hot Apex
scenarios.description: Hot-side apex with Drift currently stopped.

scenarios.label: T2C Returning
scenarios.description: Returning toward Set Point from the Hot side.

scenarios.label: T2D Cold Side
scenarios.description: The same impulse is tested after entering the opposite side.

scenarios.label: T3 Settle Capture
scenarios.description: Arrive at Set Point with residual Drift; compare Strict and Capture Window rules using Stabilize.

scenarios.label: T4 Deep Overshoot
scenarios.description: Approaching Set Point with strong Cold Drift to test controllable overshoot depth.

scenarios.label: T1 Warm Set Point
scenarios.description: Natural oscillation using the warm-blooded default Set Point +1.
